get.summary: Find Celebrity by Name ordered by rank.
get.description: Find celebrity using name ordered by rank.

Search celebrity meta data and images.  Each image in our database is related to a specific movie, TV or game title and is promotional of that title.  If you have title pages or articles about that title, then offering an image gallery on that page is obviously promotional.  If you are doing editorial about another topic and use an image from IVA, you need to reference or otherwise indicate the title of the film, TV show or game so as to be promotional.

parameters.name: Package
parameters.description: Package is based on subscription which will be set at the customer level.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: Search person using one or more Ids.  Ex:  Person/123

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: Rows to skip, used for paging. Default is 0.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: Rows to return, used for paging. Default is 10, limit is 10.

parameters.name: Includes
parameters.description: Include sub objects from the person

parameters.name: FaceDetails_Age
parameters.description: People with images with estimated age.

parameters.name: MinImageHeight
parameters.description: People with images greater than or equal to image height.

parameters.name: MinImageWidth
parameters.description: People with images greater than or equal to image width.

parameters.name: Minimum_IvaRating
parameters.description: Filter results with a minimum Rating greater than or equal to this value. (0 to 100)

parameters.name: ImageEntertainmentIds
parameters.description: People with images from EntertainmentIds.  Ex: Movie/1234

parameters.name: Gender
parameters.description: Filter people by gender. (m or f)

parameters.name: ModifiedRecordsSince
parameters.description: Filter results based on timestamp.  Returns >= value timestamp (UTC) provided.

parameters.name: SortByTimeStamp
parameters.description: Sort results based on last modified descending.  Default is sorted by _score

parameters.name: AwardYears
parameters.description: List of award years to filter on.

parameters.name: AwardTypes
parameters.description: List of award types Ex: Academy, GoldenGlobe, etc.

parameters.name: AwardCategoryTypes
parameters.description: List of award category types Ex: BestPicture, BestActor, etc.

parameters.name: AwardProgramIds
parameters.description: Limit to awards based on ProgramIds.

parameters.name: AwardPersonIds
parameters.description: Limit to awards based on PersonIds.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: Used for deep paging of record (typically beyond 10,000). Provide the NextPageToken returned from search results when using Timestamp sorting for optimal performance while paging large result sets. Skip is ignored when this parameter is provided.
